scope: Read-only purpose/module review. These observations did not justify additional product changes or new GPU qualification claims.

checks.subject: Two SSE cleanup owners and nested AnyIO shields
checks.reason: An unstarted async generator has a no-op aclose; the response must still own cleanup. cancel_once also has a timeout caller outside close. Both paths are needed.

checks.subject: Legacy qwen36 resources and compatibility modules
checks.reason: Old imports, selected cache/resource identities and manifests are compatibility boundaries. Generic runtime code does not require a public model-ID migration.

checks.subject: Alias recognition in both discovery and manifest validation
checks.reason: Registration and artifact-role validation are separate callers. Both must accept the new FreeTokenBackend alias, including MTP. The earlier missing role recognition was fixed by d7ed82cf and real alias tests are retained.

checks.subject: Separate ordinary-wheel and protected collector cache exclusions
checks.reason: They are separate asset collection paths. Historical caches remain immutable in Git but only the selected cache belongs in the ordinary wheel and the external protected runtime.

checks.subject: top_p=0 in the low-level sampler
checks.reason: Sampler.prepare already bounds top_p to MIN_P=1e-6 before probability sampling. The suspected zero-cutoff path is not passed through as zero; no change made.

checks.subject: Low-level SamplingParams
checks.reason: Fix exposed Speed input boundaries; do not append defensive validation to every trusted same-version internal structure. The exact FreeToken9 wheel remains unchanged.

checks.subject: Historical intermittent long-output token0
